title: Nói rào đón: tend to, appear to, it could be argued
summary: Nói thận trọng, tránh khẳng định tuyệt đối trong văn học thuật: tend to, appear to, it could be argued that, to some extent, may well.

dialogue.en: Is it true that young people don't read anymore?
dialogue.vi: Có đúng là giới trẻ không đọc sách nữa không?

dialogue.en: Well, they [[tend to]] read more online than in print.
dialogue.vi: À, họ có xu hướng đọc trên mạng nhiều hơn sách in.
Vậy thói quen đọc đã thay đổi?

dialogue.en: [[It appears that]] they have, [[to some extent]].
dialogue.vi: Có vẻ là vậy, ở một mức độ nào đó.

dialogue.en: [[It could be argued that]] it's simply different.
dialogue.vi: Có thể lập luận rằng nó chỉ khác thôi.

sections.heading: Tend to, appear to, seem to, suggest
sections.rule: Thay vì khẳng định chắc chắn, dùng **tend to / appear to / seem to + V** hoặc **the data suggest that…** để nói **thận trọng** như trong văn học thuật.

examples.en: Older drivers [[tend to]] drive more slowly.
examples.vi: Người lái lớn tuổi thường lái chậm hơn.
examples.why: Tend to: nói xu hướng chung, không tuyệt đối.

examples.en: The results [[appear to]] support the theory.
examples.vi: Kết quả có vẻ ủng hộ giả thuyết.

examples.en: The data [[suggest that]] prices will fall.
examples.vi: Số liệu cho thấy giá có thể sẽ giảm.

options: Students who sleep well tend to get better grades.
Students who sleep well always get better grades.

sections.heading: It could be argued that, to some extent, arguably
sections.rule: **It could be argued / It is often said that…**, **to some extent / to a certain degree**, **arguably**, **in most cases** làm lập luận mềm và khách quan hơn.

examples.en: [[It could be argued that]] the policy failed.
examples.vi: Có thể lập luận rằng chính sách đã thất bại.
examples.why: Đưa ý kiến mà không quá chắc.

examples.vi: Tôi đồng ý ở một mức độ nào đó.
examples.why: Hạn chế mức độ đồng ý.

examples.en: This is [[arguably]] the best film of the year.
examples.vi: Đây có lẽ là phim hay nhất năm.

check.prompt: ___, the city has become more crowded.

sections.heading: May well, might, could + tính từ mềm
sections.rule: **may well / might / could** và các tính từ **likely, possible, probable** giảm mức chắc chắn: *This may well be true*.

examples.vi: Đây rất có thể là lý do.
examples.why: May well: khá có khả năng.

examples.en: [[It is likely that]] costs will rise.
examples.vi: Có khả năng chi phí sẽ tăng.
examples.why: It is likely that: thận trọng.

check.prompt: The new drug ___ help some patients.

mistakes.wrong: All teenagers are addicted to phones.
mistakes.right: Many teenagers tend to be addicted to phones.

mistakes.wrong: It could argue that the plan failed.
mistakes.right: It could be argued that the plan failed.

mistakes.wrong: The results appear supporting the idea.
mistakes.right: The results appear to support the idea.
People tend to spend more online.

mistakes.wrong: This may well is the answer.
mistakes.right: This may well be the answer.

exercises.prompt: Young people ___ use social media every day.
It ___ that the experiment was successful.
It could ___ that the reform came too late.
The evidence ___ that the drug is safe.
Câu nào giống văn học thuật?
options: Too much coffee may be harmful to health.

exercises.prompt: Women ___ to live longer than men.
answers: tend

exercises.prompt: The figures ___ to show a decline.
answers: appear
seem

exercises.prompt: I agree with you to some ___.
answers: extent
degree

exercises.prompt: This may ___ be the best solution.
answers: well

exercises.vi: Người lớn tuổi thường ngủ ít hơn.
Có thể lập luận rằng nó quá đắt.

exercises.sentence: The results seem proving the theory.
answers: The results seem to prove the theory.

exercises.sentence: It could argue that prices are too high.
answers: It could be argued that prices are too high.

exercises.sentence: Children tend learning faster than adults.
answers: Children tend to learn faster than adults.

exercises.vi: Có vẻ giá nhà sẽ tiếp tục tăng.
answers: It appears that house prices will continue to rise.
It seems that house prices will continue to rise.
House prices appear likely to continue rising.
It is likely that house prices will continue to rise.
House prices seem likely to keep rising.
It appears that house prices will keep rising.

exercises.vi: Ở một mức độ nào đó, tôi đồng ý với bạn.
answers: To some extent, I agree with you.
I agree with you to some extent.
To a certain extent, I agree with you.
I agree with you to a certain extent.
To some degree, I agree with you.
